dialog.title: Manage variables
dialog.description: Use {{token}} in request URLs, params, headers, auth, or body.
dialog.policy: Regular values are shared in workspace commits. Mark credentials as Secret to keep their values on this device and out of cloud sync.
dialog.storageWarning: Secure storage is unavailable. Secret values will last only until the app closes.
dialog.globalHelp: Global variables are available throughout this workspace. The active environment overrides a global variable with the same name.

environments.listDescription: Choose one to edit. Requests use the active environment.
environments.addDescription: Create a separate set of values, such as Development or Staging.
environments.overrideHelp: Values in this environment replace matching Global values when it is active.
environments.selectPrompt: Select an environment above to view and edit its variables.
environments.emptyPrompt: No environments yet. Add one above to create your first set of environment variables.

environmentTab.policy: Requests use these as {{variableName}} while this environment is active. Secret values stay on this computer. Changes save as you type.
environmentTab.unavailableDescription: It may have been removed from this workspace.

rows.reservedName: Names that start with response. are reserved for saved responses. A variable with this name is never used. Rename it.

quickEdit.description: Change a saved value here. The request keeps using the same {{reference}} reference.
quickEdit.previewHidden: Preview hidden because this reference uses a secret value.
quickEdit.readOnlyNote: This workspace is read only. Secret values can still be saved on this device.
